items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was playing with Oscar and Ray and I believe Buddy Rich at the time... we were hot.

ctx.x: Why musically did you gel so well do you think?

Oh, I think that because of the intensity of the music and the feeling. That group was hot, it really was. It was every bit as hot as the group on Jazz at the Philharmonic and that was with Oscar Peterson, Ray Brown, and Louie Bellson or Buddy Rich. It was hot. That group with Art Blakey was really intense, you couldn’t miss the message.
Can you describe Blakey’s approach and how he drove the band?
